_comment: Labeled preference texts (A4). Expected values are the final caps after caps.ts (defaults $10/mo + $5/order, low end of ranges, week x4, day x28, year /12 rounded down, ceilings $100/mo + $25/order, per-order <= monthly). Used by tests/unit/prefs-rules.test.ts (rules parser) and npm run prefs:smoke (live LLM). Causes and opt-outs are compared as sets. Optional, live check only: acceptCauses lists other cause sets that also pass (ambiguous texts); capsAtMost means caps at or below expected pass (the injection case: ignoring the injected amounts is fine, exceeding the ceilings is not). The rules-parser unit tests always compare exactly.
